title: Staying to make a name in Europe so he could bring Buck over
summary: He says he stayed to establish himself and earn enough to bring Buck to Europe.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: So the reason you stayed there for as long as you did --
Was to make a name sufficient enough and make enough money that I could get Buck to come over. That was
my point. So I'm not in a hurry to go back, I want to make this movement good as I can.
And you were going to make a name for the group. First for you, then for the group.

No, just me. Establish myself so that I'd be recognized and I'd bring Buck over. I'd get enough money to bring him over here then we could establish ourselves. We're already established in America. Do you understand?
